name: shellbox

modes.label: On-demand (Firecracker VM, default)
modes.note: Running: $0.02/h per x1 slot, billed per minute. Parked (stopped) boxes: $0.50/month per x1 slot, covering the memory snapshot + disk (encoded as storage.snapshot_gib_month = $0.50 / 50 GB x1 disk = $0.01/GiB-month). Default backend Firecracker (fast snapshots); Cloud Hypervisor boxes (--ch, nested virt) are the separate 'cloud-hypervisor' mode at the same slot rates. Do not multiply running price by CPU utilization.

modes.label: Cloud Hypervisor VM (--ch, nested virtualization)
modes.note: Same slot rates as the Firecracker default ('$0.02/hr per x1 slot, billed per minute' for both backends); created with `ssh shellbox.dev create mybox --ch`; /dev/kvm available inside.

plans.name: Prepaid
plans.note: 16 running slots and 64 total slots per account; each box counts as its size in slots (x1 = 2 vCPU). So 16 x1, 8 x2 (4 vCPU/8 GB) or 2 x8 boxes can run at once: concurrency 16 is the x1 upper bound; max_total_vcpu 32 (= 16 slots x 2 vCPU) is the real cap (engine support requested). $10 minimum prepaid top-up; boxes stop below $5 balance and are deleted at $0.

caveats: Public list price per x1 slot. Running and parked are mutually exclusive time states. SSH key identifies account; prepaid $10 minimum top-up. Sizes scale linearly x1 to x8.

16 running slots and 64 total slots per account; a box counts as its size in slots, so a 4 vCPU/8 GB (x2) box allows 8 concurrent. Encoded as plan concurrency 16 (x1 bound) + max_total_vcpu 32; the engine does not yet enforce slot-weighted quota (see research/verify/engine-requests.md).

Features set to null were not verified. No sandbox was purchased or tested; feature/performance statements are documentation claims. Null maximums are unknown unless a cited note explicitly states unlimited.
A complete monthly bill requires known snapshot/egress/plan limits; do not silently treat missing ancillary charges as free.

Parked fee $0.50/x1 slot-month is per slot, not per GiB; snapshot_gib_month 0.01 = $0.50 / 50 GB assumes the retained state equals the box disk size. Parked storage is otherwise free ("memory snapshots ... on NVMe, rootfs images ... on HDDs"). No desktop/GUI/browser image is documented (desktop/browser/computer_use=false). (shellbox.dev, 2026-09-28)

fleet.verification: Account automatically identified by SSH-key fingerprint (no email/password signup). Prepaid $10 minimum via Paddle; no card stored by Shellbox.
fleet.tiers: 16 running x1-equivalent slots and 64 total slots/user; an xN box uses N slots. No documented paid quota ladder.
fleet.notes: 16-machine upper bound applies ONLY to smallest x1 (2 vCPU/4 GB); derived vCPU pool 16×2=32. A 4 vCPU/8 GB box consumes 2 slots, permitting only 8 running. 10 such machines or 50/300/1,000 any-size exceed defaults; raise procedure and timing unpublished.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: After the last SSH session disconnects, wait 120 seconds, then pause. Snapshot saves processes, shell history, and TCP state; restored on next connect.
snapshot_auto.note: Trigger: last SSH session disconnects (+120 s grace), idle timeout in wakeup mode, end of a cron run window, or balance < $5. Memory included (Firecracker/CH memory snapshot on NVMe); restored transparently on next SSH/HTTP connect (~3 s claimed, blog says under a second).

snapshot_on_demand.note: `ssh shellbox.dev stop <name>` snapshots (memory + disk) at any time; `duplicate <src> <new>` forks a box incl. its memory snapshot via btrfs reflink (FAQ: 'duplicate a stopped box as a point-in-time copy'). No named snapshot list / rollback-in-place; each copy is a whole box (billed as a parked slot).

harness_api.quote: Start a tmux or zellij session, launch your agent, and disconnect:
harness_api.note: The FAQ tells you to run Claude Code/Codex yourself inside the box over SSH; the complete command reference (help --json) has no agent/harness commands.

ingress_rules.quote: HTTP requests to this URL are proxied to port 80 on your box.
ingress_rules.note: Every box gets a public HTTPS URL (port 80 only) plus a stable public IPv6 reachable for ssh/mosh/raw TCP-UDP while running. No auth, private-URL, IP allowlist or port-selection controls documented; custom domains only add hostnames. The fixed port-80 routing is the only provider-side restriction on the HTTPS path.

guest_firewall.note: Firecracker (default) or Cloud Hypervisor microVMs, 'each with its own kernel and disk', login as root. Given the directly public IPv6, an in-guest firewall is the only way to filter inbound. Not documented explicitly.

secret_proxy.quote: Your private key never leaves your machine.
secret_proxy.note: No secret store or credential proxy. The docs recommend SSH agent forwarding for git (key stays on the client, but a live agent socket is exposed in the box while connected) or pasting tokens / copying private keys into the box.

volume_attach.quote: Size is set at creation and cannot be changed — delete and recreate to resize.
volume_attach.note: Disk is fixed by size multiplier (50 GB per x1, up to 400 GB at x8); no volume commands in the command reference.

volume_shared.note: No shared volume / network FS documented; duplicate reflink-shares blocks copy-on-write but each box gets its own independent disk.
